concrete_defects.defect: Green spill/fringing on hair edges, particularly noticeable on the top and sides.
Slight green spill/halo around the glasses frames, especially visible when the subject moves their head.
Rough cutout edges and slight green spill on the ear edges, more prominent on the right ear.
Minor green spill and slightly rough edges on the shoulder lines, particularly when the shoulders move.
Flicker and slight green spill on the moving fingers, causing them to appear less defined.

mild_non_blocking_edge_observations: The overall key has a slightly soft, almost feathered edge, which contributes to some of the fringing.
There's a subtle, almost imperceptible glow around the subject's silhouette at times, suggesting a slight halo effect.
verdict_normal_light_background: The exact same key would likely be acceptable against a normal light background, but the subtle green spill and rough edges would still be present and potentially noticeable upon close inspection. While less glaring than on a dark background, these imperfections would still detract from a perfectly clean composite. Further refinement of the key is recommended for optimal results.
